notes: «قال حدثني صاحب» names no one: unnamed link (rule 8); «قال سألت رسول الله» is his own first-person words, so the speaker is an unnamed first person (rule 11)
«- وأشار إلى دار عبد الله -» is a remark on the place, not a link (rule 6); «هذه الدار» is the house, not a name
«أبي» is a bare kinship word: relation link
